tools.name: mail-authenticate
tools.description: Sign in to Outlook as yourself (device code). Returns a URL and a code; open the URL, enter the code and sign in. Sign-in completes in the background and is shared with the CLI.

tools.name: mail-auth-status
tools.description: Show the Outlook sign-in state, the signed-in account, the delegated permissions the sign-in carries, and for each tool group (read, write, drafts, send, delete) whether the permission is there and whether its switch is on. drafts.attachFromLink says whether a SharePoint or OneDrive link can be attached as a file or only inserted as a link. access.calendar reports the calendar groups (read, shared, write, invite, delegate, recording) the same way.

tools.name: mail-logout
tools.description: Sign out of Outlook and delete the cached sign-in. The CLI is signed out too.

tools.name: mail-list-folders
tools.description: List the top-level mail folders with their unread and total counts. A folder id, or a well-known name (inbox, archive, drafts, sentitems, deleteditems), can be passed to mail-list-messages.

tools.name: mail-list-categories
tools.description: List the categories defined in the mailbox (name and colour), so mail-set-categories can use a name that already exists. Every message summary also carries the categories set on that message.

tools.name: mail-list-messages
tools.description: List messages in a folder, newest first, as summaries (subject, sender, received time, read state, preview, id). Filters combine: unread only, sender, received since/until, has attachments.

folder.description: Well-known name (inbox, archive, drafts, sentitems, deleteditems) or folder id. Default inbox

since.description: Received on or after, ISO date or date-time, e.g. 2026-09-01

until.description: Received on or before, ISO date or date-time

hasAttachments.description: Only messages with (true) or without (false) attachments

tools.name: mail-search-messages
tools.description: Search the whole mailbox (Microsoft Search, relevance order). Supports KQL such as from:jdoe@example.com, subject:budget, hasattachments:true, received>=2026-09-01. Returns summaries.

tools.name: mail-get-message
tools.description: Read one message: sender, recipients, body as readable text (links kept), and its attachment list with ids for mail-download-attachment.

id.description: Message id from mail-list-messages or mail-search-messages

tools.name: mail-get-conversation
tools.description: Read every message in a conversation (thread), oldest first, each with its body as text and its attachment list.

tools.name: mail-download-attachment
tools.description: Save a file attachment to the download folder (OUTLOOK_DOWNLOAD_DIR, default ~/Downloads/mcp-outlook) and return its path. Never overwrites an existing file. Embedded items and cloud-file links are refused.

tools.name: mail-create-draft
tools.description: Create a new draft in Drafts. Nothing is sent; review it in Outlook or send it with mail-send-draft. Off unless OUTLOOK_ENABLE_DRAFTS=true (while unset, it follows OUTLOOK_ENABLE_WRITE).

format.description: Body format (default markdown). HTML is sanitised.

tools.name: mail-create-reply-draft
tools.description: Create a reply (or reply-all) draft with your text above the quoted thread. Nothing is sent. Off unless OUTLOOK_ENABLE_DRAFTS=true (while unset, it follows OUTLOOK_ENABLE_WRITE).

messageId.description: Id of the message to reply to

format.description: Body format (default markdown). HTML is sanitised.

tools.name: mail-create-forward-draft
tools.description: Create a forward draft to new recipients, with an optional note above the forwarded message. Nothing is sent. Off unless OUTLOOK_ENABLE_DRAFTS=true (while unset, it follows OUTLOOK_ENABLE_WRITE).

messageId.description: Id of the message to forward

body.description: Optional note above the forwarded message

format.description: Body format (default markdown). HTML is sanitised.

tools.name: mail-update-draft
tools.description: Change a draft: recipients, subject or body. A given body replaces the whole body. Nothing is sent. Off unless OUTLOOK_ENABLE_DRAFTS=true (while unset, it follows OUTLOOK_ENABLE_WRITE).

format.description: Body format (default markdown). HTML is sanitised.

tools.name: mail-add-draft-attachment
tools.description: Attach a file to a draft: give filePath (a local file) or url (a SharePoint or OneDrive link), not both. A local file must be inside your home folder; hidden folders and credential files (.env, id_*, .pem, .key, .p12, .pfx) are refused. A linked file is read into memory with the Outlook sign-in and never saved to disk; if the sign-in may not read it (needs Files.Read.All), a link to the file is put in the draft instead and the result says attached: false. Size cap OUTLOOK_MAX_ATTACHMENT_MB (default 25). Nothing is sent. Off unless OUTLOOK_ENABLE_DRAFTS=true (while unset, it follows OUTLOOK_ENABLE_WRITE).

filePath.description: Absolute path, or a path starting with ~/

tools.name: mail-mark-read
tools.description: Mark a message read or unread. Off unless OUTLOOK_ENABLE_WRITE=true.

tools.name: mail-move-message
tools.description: Move a message to another folder. The message gets a new id, which is returned. Off unless OUTLOOK_ENABLE_WRITE=true.

destinationFolder.description: Well-known name (archive, inbox, drafts, deleteditems, junkemail) or a folder id

tools.name: mail-flag-message
tools.description: Flag a message for follow-up, mark the flag complete, or clear it. Off unless OUTLOOK_ENABLE_WRITE=true.

tools.name: mail-set-categories
tools.description: Add and remove named categories on one message. Categories you do not name are kept: the current list is read and merged before it is written back. Names match without regard to case. Use a name from mail-list-categories; a new name is set on the message but gets no colour. Returns the categories before and after. Off unless OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CATEGORIES=true (independent of OUTLOOK_ENABLE_WRITE).

tools.name: mail-send-draft
tools.description: Send an existing draft by id, as the signed-in user. This sends real mail and cannot be undone. Off unless OUTLOOK_ENABLE_SEND=true.

tools.name: mail-send
tools.description: Compose and send a message in one call, saved to Sent Items. This sends real mail and cannot be undone; prefer mail-create-draft when the user should review first. Off unless OUTLOOK_ENABLE_SEND=true.

format.description: Body format (default markdown). HTML is sanitised.

tools.name: mail-delete-message
tools.description: Delete a message: it moves to Deleted Items and can be recovered there. Needs confirm: true. Off unless OUTLOOK_ENABLE_DELETE=true.

tools.name: calendar-list-calendars
tools.description: List your calendars, plus the shared calendars you have added in Outlook, with whether you can edit each.

tools.name: calendar-list-events
tools.description: List events between start and end, oldest first, for you or a colleague whose calendar is shared with you. Each occurrence of a repeating meeting is listed; its seriesMasterId identifies the whole series. Private events show as busy with no details.

start.description: Start: ISO date or date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00. Read in OUTLOOK_TIME_ZONE (default the machine zone) unless it ends in Z or an offset.

end.description: End: ISO date or date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00. Read in OUTLOOK_TIME_ZONE (default the machine zone) unless it ends in Z or an offset.

user.description: A colleague's email, to read their calendar instead of yours. Needs their calendar shared with you and OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CALENDAR_SHARED=true.

tools.name: calendar-get-event
tools.description: Get one event in full: attendees with their responses, the Teams link and the invitation text (untrusted content).

user.description: A colleague's email, to read their calendar instead of yours. Needs their calendar shared with you and OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CALENDAR_SHARED=true.

tools.name: calendar-get-schedule
tools.description: Free/busy for several people at once, for anyone in your organisation, even if they have shared nothing. availabilityView has one digit per interval: 0 free, 1 tentative, 2 busy, 3 out of office, 4 working elsewhere. Subjects appear only where their settings allow.

start.description: Start: ISO date or date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00. Read in OUTLOOK_TIME_ZONE (default the machine zone) unless it ends in Z or an offset.

end.description: End: ISO date or date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00. Read in OUTLOOK_TIME_ZONE (default the machine zone) unless it ends in Z or an offset.

tools.name: calendar-find-meeting-times
tools.description: Suggest meeting slots in working hours when every attendee and you are free, between start and end.

attendees.description: Email addresses of the people who must attend

start.description: Earliest start: ISO date or date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00. Read in OUTLOOK_TIME_ZONE (default the machine zone) unless it ends in Z or an offset.

end.description: Latest end: ISO date or date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00. Read in OUTLOOK_TIME_ZONE (default the machine zone) unless it ends in Z or an offset.

tools.name: calendar-create-event
tools.description: Create an appointment, or a meeting with attendees. A meeting with attendees gets a Teams link unless teamsMeeting is false, and the invitations go out at once. No attendees: needs OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CALENDAR_WRITE=true. Notifies anyone: needs OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CALENDAR_INVITE=true, and sends immediately.

start.description: Start: ISO date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00, read in OUTLOOK_TIME_ZONE (default the machine zone) unless it ends in Z or an offset.

end.description: End: ISO date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00, read in OUTLOOK_TIME_ZONE (default the machine zone) unless it ends in Z or an offset.

teamsMeeting.description: Add a Teams link (default: yes when there are attendees)

recordAutomatically.description: Record the Teams meeting automatically when it starts (default false). Records video too. Your own calendar only.

calendarOwner.description: The calendar owner's email, to act on their calendar as their delegate. Needs OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CALENDAR_DELEGATE=true.

tools.name: calendar-update-event
tools.description: Change an event you organise: time, subject, location, text or attendees. Pass an occurrence id to change one occurrence, or its seriesMasterId to change the whole series. For a meeting with attendees the update goes out at once. No attendees: needs OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CALENDAR_WRITE=true. Notifies anyone: needs OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CALENDAR_INVITE=true, and sends immediately.

eventId.description: Event id, or a seriesMasterId for the whole series

start.description: New start: ISO date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00, read in OUTLOOK_TIME_ZONE (default the machine zone) unless it ends in Z or an offset.

end.description: New end: ISO date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00, read in OUTLOOK_TIME_ZONE (default the machine zone) unless it ends in Z or an offset.

recordAutomatically.description: Record the Teams meeting automatically when it starts (default false). Records video too. Your own calendar only.

calendarOwner.description: The calendar owner's email, to act on their calendar as their delegate. Needs OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CALENDAR_DELEGATE=true.

tools.name: calendar-cancel-event
tools.description: Cancel a meeting you organise, sending attendees the comment, or delete your own appointment (it moves to Deleted Items). For a meeting someone else organises, decline it with calendar-respond-to-event instead. No attendees: needs OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CALENDAR_WRITE=true. Notifies anyone: needs OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CALENDAR_INVITE=true, and sends immediately.

comment.description: Message sent to attendees with the cancellation

calendarOwner.description: The calendar owner's email, to act on their calendar as their delegate. Needs OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CALENDAR_DELEGATE=true.

tools.name: calendar-respond-to-event
tools.description: Accept, tentatively accept or decline an invitation, with an optional comment. The organiser is told at once. To suggest another time, give proposedStart and proposedEnd with tentativelyAccept or decline (not accept); the organiser gets a new-time proposal they can accept. Needs OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CALENDAR_INVITE=true.

proposedStart.description: Proposed new start: ISO date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T16:00, read in OUTLOOK_TIME_ZONE unless it ends in Z or an offset.

proposedEnd.description: Proposed new end, same format as proposedStart.

calendarOwner.description: The calendar owner's email, to act on their calendar as their delegate. Needs OUTLOOK_ENABLE_CALENDAR_DELEGATE=true.
